technical_and_design_decisions: Treat the increment as work in the existing Spring Cloud/Data Flow-related codebase referenced by the stories, rather than as a new implementation of the Spring Framework itself.
Use the repository's existing build system, test conventions, SPI abstractions, deployment model, and CI pipeline wherever possible.
For BOM documentation, document the supported template syntax, parameter substitution rules, dependency inclusion behavior, examples, and limitations without introducing a new BOM mechanism.

Extend Lattice, CC, and YARN integration tests using the existing test fixtures and external-service abstractions; use mocks or containerized test dependencies where the repository already supports them.
Add unit tests around SPI-specific parsing, validation, lifecycle, and error-handling branches, prioritizing uncovered behavior rather than rewriting existing tests.

Fix the container shutdown issue by ensuring stream definitions containing quoted JDBC arguments and pipe-separated modules are parsed and represented consistently during Admin UI shutdown and undeployment.
Support multiple binder connection factories through explicit binder selection/configuration while preserving the current single-factory configuration as the backward-compatible default.
Validate the multiple-binder implementation with tests covering independent producer and consumer binding selections, default behavior, invalid configuration, and application context startup.
Run the affected module tests, broader regression tests, static checks, and documentation/build validation before considering the increment complete.
assumptions: The existing source repository, build environment, CI configuration, and test infrastructure are available and buildable without major dependency or platform migration.
The requested increment targets an existing legacy Spring Cloud/Data Flow-style product even though the introductory text describes Spring Framework generally.
The exact implementations of the Lattice, CC, and YARN SPIs already exist; this increment requires coverage improvements rather than new SPI functionality.
Test environments or suitable mocks are available for the Lattice, CC, and YARN integration tests, and no new production-grade infrastructure must be provisioned.
The BOM feature and its syntax exist in the product; the requested work is reference documentation and examples, not implementation of BOM processing.
The Admin UI shutdown defect can be corrected within the existing stream/container lifecycle and command-parsing code without redesigning the deployment architecture.
The multiple-binder requirement applies to the existing binder configuration model and can be implemented without changing external broker protocols.

One developer performs analysis, implementation, testing, documentation, code review preparation, and regression verification; estimates include normal local troubleshooting but exclude waiting time for external teams or infrastructure.
Effort estimates are work-hours and represent the single most likely effort, not elapsed calendar duration.

activities.activity_description: Inspect the relevant modules, existing SPI implementations, test fixtures, deployment lifecycle, binder configuration, BOM behavior, and CI commands; identify affected classes and create an implementation plan.

Document how users define and consume BOM templates, including external library inclusion, dynamic parameters, representative examples, prerequisites, and limitations; validate the documentation against the current implementation and documentation build.
Add or enhance end-to-end tests for the Lattice SPI covering the principal lifecycle and integration paths, failure handling, and CI-compatible setup and cleanup.
Add or enhance integration tests for the CC SPI covering deployment, operation, lifecycle behavior, error handling, and repeatable cleanup in the CI environment.
Add or enhance integration tests for the YARN SPI covering application or stream lifecycle, representative configuration, failure paths, and reliable CI cleanup.
Add focused unit tests for Lattice SPI mapping, validation, lifecycle decisions, error handling, and other currently under-tested branches using existing mocks and test utilities.
Add focused unit tests for YARN SPI configuration, command or resource mapping, validation, lifecycle behavior, and failure handling.

activities.activity_name: Admin UI container shutdown defect diagnosis and fix
activities.activity_description: Reproduce the JDBC-to-HDFS stream shutdown failure, trace parsing and lifecycle handling for quoted stream definitions, implement the minimal compatible fix, and add regression coverage for the supplied stream definition and related shutdown cases.

Design and implement explicit selection of more than one binder connection factory, including configuration binding, factory registration or lookup, producer and consumer routing, backward-compatible defaults, validation, and useful diagnostics.

Create unit and integration-level tests for multiple binder factories, including independent consume and publish selections, default single-factory behavior, invalid configurations, isolation, and application startup.

Run affected and broader regression suites, resolve test failures, perform static and formatting checks, verify CI compatibility, update release or change notes as appropriate, and prepare the completed changes for review.
